scaleBeatText: 👑 Speakers from Emberhold, Stonebridge, Thornfield ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
refuseBeatText: 👑 Speakers from Emberhold, Stonebridge, Thornfield ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
◈ SYSTEM: "Noted. The offer is withdrawn — permanently. No court. No oath. No tithe. The audience is... divided. Half of them just subscribed."

🚶 Haven refuses the scale. Every kcal stays in Haven's pantry — no one's court, no one's oath, no pool shares, no tariffs. The price, said plainly: no polity logistics (tribute comes in whole, never ×1.25), no league to call when the late waves come, and the table stays distant. Coalition or death — Haven walks it alone.
